message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality data, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
Here are a few reliable ways to check it right now:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> and enter “Los Angeles, CA.” |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Go to <https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/>. |
| **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or your phone’s weather widget) | Many include an AQI indicator. |
| **Local news sites** | They often report on smog alerts. |

If you need the data programmatically, you can use the AirNow API or the AQICN API (both require an API key). Let me know if you’d like help setting that up!
